user_query: I'm planning a surprise anniversary party for my grandparents. Can you suggest some nostalgic decorations and provide me with some heartwarming quotes to include in the party invitations? Additionally, find a venue with a dance floor and live music. Also, recommend some classic dishes for the party menu.

TaskList.description: Search for nostalgic decoration ideas for anniversary parties.
Collect heartwarming quotes suitable for anniversary invitations.
Find a venue that has a dance floor and live music for the anniversary party.
Recommend classic dishes that would be suitable for the anniversary party menu.
